% strikethrough — text struck through with a drawn line, which GFM writes as ~~text~~.
%
% A PDF has no strikethrough attribute: ulem's \sout draws a rule across the words.
% So the style is recoverable only by finding a line drawn through the middle of a
% run of glyphs, and not under them. One struck phrase sits mid-sentence, between
% plain words, so the extent of the strike is part of what is checked.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{lmodern}
\usepackage[normalem]{ulem}
\pagestyle{empty}
\begin{document}
The meeting moves from \sout{Tuesday afternoon} to Thursday morning.
\end{document}
